dynamic_line.yes: Heh, alright, the Feds.  Tell ya' what I got somethin' special for yah'.  Swing by heah and see me.
dynamic_line.no: The Feds.  If they're payin', let's do it.  If they're all laid up in a cabin, I think your best bet may be explosives.  Heah.  Take this grenade.  Don't ask.

responses.text: [take the grenade] Thanks, Pat.  I'll put it to good use?
